reviews.notes: Two ESCO fan-out clusters dominate: ~40 'specialised seller of <product>' retail rows (all ISCO 5223) and ~35 'wholesale merchant in <commodity>' rows (all ISCO 3324), each differing only by product vertical. These are legitimate ESCO occupations but collapse to a handful of parent roles (specialised seller, wholesale merchant, sales assistant); listed reps are the most granular. Recommend consolidating verticals to 5-8 representative seller/merchant roles. Removed 13 SOC group-label junk rows. True sales-career spine (sales manager/director, commercial director, CMO, account/key-account additions, sales engineer, technical sales rep, business development) is otherwise sound.

reviews.notes: Two structural problems. (1) The entire ESCO import/export (1324/3331) + '<commodity> distribution manager' (1324) fan-out — ~90 rows — is DUPLICATED verbatim from D034 Supply Chain Management; it belongs primarily in D034, not Logistics. Logistics proper is the transport/warehouse/freight core here (drivers 8331/8332, materials handling & warehouse 9333, forklift 8344, stevedore, dispatchers) which is sound. (2) A 5-role event-management cluster (3332: event manager, venue programmer, wedding planner, event assistant, venue director) plus junk 'Meeting, Convention, and Event Planners' is wholly off-domain — belongs in an Events/Hospitality domain. Flagged the duplicated commodity clusters and the event cluster as overfanout; removed 24 SOC group-label junk rows (several off-domain: oil/gas pumping, refuse collection, cleaning, manufacturing feeders). Key gap: fleet manager. Recommend de-duplicating the commodity trade/distribution clusters against D034 and moving the event cluster out.
